purpose: Measure the complete default-browser VNDB import effect of replacing Uint8Array.from with the typed-array copy constructor for shared parser text
fixtureIntegrity: Locked SHA-256 required before every observation
timingBoundary: Browser monotonic file-input change through completed import UI; separate traces and memory observations are not timing evidence
controlPolicy: Unchanged exact-source qualification schedule: four warmups, six alternating candidate pairs, and two interleaved identical-baseline AC/CA control pairs on each host
mediaPolicy: Unchanged production browser storage path; sampled media byte validation during timed observations and separate exhaustive media byte validation for both source arms after timing
failurePolicy: Retain every scheduled observation and failure; stop at the first failed observation; do not replace observations or trim tails
decisionPolicy: No PR from component-only gains or an incomplete cohort. Require replicated useful complete-import improvement beyond identical-code controls, preserved semantics/storage, and passing existing prospective memory screen. Assess improvement against implementation complexity.
memoryPolicy: Unchanged qualification gate: all observations covered; paired median PSS/private increases at most 5%, individual pairs at most 10%
localScreenLimitation: The prior Node six-pair VNDB screen was incomplete after SIGKILL and used an in-memory SQLite media fallback. Its successful prefix is excluded from performance qualification; term-sidecar hashes and media counts did not establish SQLite media BLOB parity.
